display_long_description:
⚠️ READ BEFORE PURCHASE: HOW IT WORKS
Due to Meta Quest system limits, third-party keyboards cannot pop up inside other games.
Workflow:

Type in this App (Zhuyin/Pinyin/Sucheng/Voice).

Click "Copy" (Auto-saved to clipboard).

Switch & Paste in your target App.

Compatibility:

Supported: Browsers, Notion, Discord, and apps that support system pasting.

NOT Supported: DeoVR (due to its own software limits).

YouTube Users: YouTube has a built-in keyboard. Buy only if you need Offline Voice or T/S Conversion.

🎯 Professional Chinese Input for Meta Quest
Stop struggling with English keyboards to type Chinese! Chinese Input - Zhuyin & Pinyin is the complete solution for your VR communication needs.

🌟 4 Powerful Input Methods
🎤 Offline Voice Input: Fastest & Private. Processed locally on-device. No internet required. Perfect for long text and quick searches.

📝 Zhuyin (Bopomofo): Standard 4-row layout for Taiwan users.

⚡ Sucheng (Quick): Efficient first/last code selection for HK users.

🔤 Pinyin: Standard QWERTY layout with smart matching for Simplified Chinese.

🔄 Conversion & Learning
One-Click Conversion: Seamlessly switch between Traditional and Simplified Chinese.

Learning Hub: Instantly view Zhuyin/Pinyin/Sucheng codes for any character.

💡 Efficiency Bonus: One-Click Search
Skip the "Paste" step! Type your keywords and click "Search" to open your browser and go straight to Google results instantly.
